target_days.source: User statement: 'I want to charge it about once a month.'

runtime.duty_description: Wake every 15 minutes, read the sensor, associate to Wi-Fi, publish, sleep. Roughly 9 s awake per cycle.

must_fit.source: Calipers on the interior of the bought ABS box, 2026-09-21.
must_fit.reason: Everything has to sit inside the box that already exists.

Calipers, lid closed, allowing for the lid's internal ribs.

temp_min_c.source: Local winter minimum in an unheated greenhouse.

temp_max_c.how_to_close: Log it for a week with the sensor itself before trusting the cell's temperature rating.

environment.humidity: Condensing at night. The board needs conformal coating or a desiccant sachet.
environment.ingress_rating_target: none - the bought box is splash resistant only

range_target_m.source: Distance from the greenhouse to the house access point.
range_target_m.how_to_close: Range-test in place, inside the closed box, in the greenhouse - not on the desk next to the router.

interactions.notes: One LED, lit only while awake.
Forces an immediate reading. Doubles as the deep-sleep wake source.

non_goals: No display. The data lives on the network.
No local storage. A missed reading is not worth an SD card.
No enclosure design - see project.json skipped phase 8.
